items.title: Two killed, at least 10 injured in shooting in Polish city of Krakow, TVN24 reports
items.brief: At least five people have been killed and about a dozen more injured in a shooting incident in the main market square of Krakow, Poland, on Saturday evening, according to Polish police.

items.title: A promising drug for an inherited heart risk flops, stunning doctors
items.brief: In the course of scientific discovery, there are triumphant moments when researchers present their findings to a rapt audience that jumps to its feet for a standing ovation.

items.title: 2 skydivers die after colliding midair in California and their parachutes become entangled
items.brief: Two skydivers who were taking part in an organized skydiving event in California were killed after colliding midair and plummeting to the ground.

items.title: New Zealand in political limbo after knife-edge election
items.brief: New Zealand voters face weeks of political limbo after a knife-edge election left the country’s conservative coalition government at risk of losing its majority following just a single term in office.

items.title: He left NYC after 9/11 for a new life in South America
items.brief: In our roundup of travel stories this week: The Englishman who walked around the world, why Norway is making toilets “great again,” plus a New Yorker driven to start life over in Argentina in the wake of 9/11.

items.title: Washington made Moscow a pariah. Now a tanker of Russian diesel is headed for US shores
items.brief: When Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022, the response from the United States and its allies was swift and brutal.
